full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white caricature drawing gathers several theatrical faces in a tight overlapping cluster. At the left, a broad hat and long hooked nose create a dark silhouette; below, a square-jawed face with drooping eyes sits amid curling smoke-like lines. Near the center, a sharp-cheeked figure looks upward, while a severe face in a high collar appears behind. On the right, another wide hat frames a smiling profile that points toward the outer edge. A pale architectural column and decorative scroll are suggested in the background, but most of the page remains white. The expressions and profiles are exaggerated through long noses, raised brows, pointed chins and sweeping hair shapes. Deep black areas of hats and clothing anchor the group, while fine gray hatching gives cheeks and shadows a lighter texture. The figures overlap without a realistic spatial setting, more like a theater company compressed into one lively drawing. Illumination is even, as on a white illustration board, with contrast generated by ink density rather than cast light. Loose curls at the lower left balance the hard diagonals of the upper right. The composition is dense at the center but airy at the margins, using economical lines to distinguish many personalities. Its mood is witty, urbane and energetic.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白漫画画把几张戏剧化面孔紧密叠在一组。左侧宽帽与长弯鼻构成深剪影；下方一张方下颌、眼皮下垂的脸处于卷曲烟线之间。中央附近一位颧骨锐利者向上望，后面高衣领里露出严肃面孔。右侧另一顶宽帽框住朝外边缘的微笑侧面。背景隐约暗示浅色建筑柱与装饰卷纹，但大部分纸面仍是白色。长鼻、上挑眉、尖下巴和扫动发形夸张了表情与侧面。帽和衣服的实黑区固定人群，细灰排线为脸颊和阴影添轻纹理。形体重叠却没有写实空间，更像剧团人物被压进一幅活跃画里。光均匀，如白色插画板，明暗由墨密度而非投射光形成。左下松散卷线平衡右上坚硬斜线。构图中央密集、边缘通透，用经济的线区别多种个性。情绪机智、都市而有能量。
style_prompt_en: The ink caricature drawing uses economical sweeping contours, sharp angular profiles and large black shapes against white paper. Fine gray hatching adds intermediate tone without dulling the high contrast. Closely overlapping forms create a dense center, while loose curls and blank margins keep it airy. Even page light leaves expression to line weight and silhouette rather than realistic shading. The rhythm is witty, quick and theatrical.
style_prompt_zh: 这种墨线漫画画在白纸前使用经济的扫线轮廓、尖锐棱角侧形和大片实黑。细灰排线加入中间调，却不减弱高对比。紧密重叠形体制造密集中心，松卷线与空白边缘保留通透。均匀纸面光让表现力来自线重与剪影，而非写实明暗。节奏机智、迅捷且富戏剧感。
theme_en: A cluster of theatrical caricature faces in black ink
theme_zh: 黑墨线里聚集的一组戏剧化漫画面孔
name: Al Hirschfeld
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
